newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring, white bids up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring, white bids up.

text.p: Cash bids for spring wheat were mostly higher in line with gains in MGE wheat futures and amid sluggish farm sales, several dealers said.
There was some movement via trains but the truck market was completely shut down, a Minneapolis dealer said.
"Farmers are not selling much right now. The only shipments we are seeing is by rail (and that is) just due to guaranteed purchased freight that elevators are getting and have to fill," he said.
May MGE spring wheat futures closed 6-1/4 cents higher at $3.92-1/2 per bushel.
In the northern Plains, Montana and North Dakota dealers said snow hampered the movement of grain.
Bids for soft white wheat also firmed but movement was slow, Oregon and Washington state merchandisers said.
